name: bearound-cordova-example
description: Example app for the Bearound Cordova plugin.

scripts.plugin:pack: rm -rf .plugin && mkdir .plugin && (cd .. && npm pack --silent --pack-destination example/.plugin) && tar -xzf .plugin/*.tgz -C .plugin
scripts.plugin:install: npm run plugin:pack && (cordova plugin rm @bearound/cordova-sdk --nosave || true) && cordova plugin add ./.plugin/package --nosave
